thread:
michael: Quick check — during last night's canary we’re seeing user identifiers and snippets of prompt text in debug logs. Posting a tiny redacted snippet below. Need eng-security + legal: scope of exposure? Should we halt rollout? cc @claire (comms)

priya: Context: canary ran in us-west-2 on 4 hosts, ~2k requests, KV cache debug logging was enabled for the run.

jonah: Is this the same pattern we filtered earlier? Looks like user_id but not full tokens. Snippet: ```[INFO] request_id=abc123 user_id=usr_0x9f7a prompt="order id 1234: confirm address..."```

michael: Prompt contains partial user text — could be PII. Treat as potential exposure until proven otherwise. Sec, can you triage who has read access and where these logs are retained? Also: retention period?

sec-bot: Automated: incident ticket INF-2026-423 opened for log exposure triage. Assigned: @emily (legal), @priya (oncall).

emily (legal): Will review. If there are full auth tokens or SSNs, we need customer comms. Otherwise internal mitigation + notes may suffice. Need count of occurrences, examples redacted, and retention info.

priya: Running queries now. Preliminary: ~28 unique user_id values, no regex matches for token patterns. Logs written to ephemeral s3 bucket (30d), access restricted to eng-oncall, eng-logs, and sec-audit roles.

claire (comms): If it's hashed user_ids and no PII, we can do internal post-incident note only. If any customer-identifying PII, we'll need coordinated external comms. Keep me posted.

jonah: I pushed a quick PR to stop writing prompt content to debug logs (PR #4123). If we can hotpatch to canary, do it now and we should block further rollout until verified.

michael: Agreed. Priya please share counts + one anonymized example (replace id chars) and mark rollout blocked until fix confirmed.

priya: Will post in ~15m.

sec-bot: Access checklist: current IAM roles with read permissions: eng-oncall, eng-logs, sec-audit. Any access changes must go through INF-2026-423 ticket.

claire (comms): Preparing template in case external notice needed. Tag me once we confirm PII vs hashed ids.

emily (legal): Legal standby. If tokens are present -> escalate to privacy@redwood and prepare regulatory review.

priya: Query results: 28 unique user_id hashes, 0 matches for token regex, 0 SSN-like patterns. Redacted example: ```user_id=usr_XXXXX request_id=abc123 prompt="<REDACTED>"``` Logs older than 7d are archived but still in S3 for up to 30d.

michael: Thanks. Jonah, can you merge & deploy the PR and confirm the hotfix is active on canary?

jonah: Merged and deployed to canary. Logging now strips prompt content. Increased log-level to WARN for canary nodes.

priya: Verified new logs — no prompt payloads present. I'll monitor for 24h then close INF-2026-423.

claire (comms): Notifying product/legal. No external comms required at this time. :white_check_mark:

emily (legal): Confirmed — hold external comms unless new evidence emerges.

michael: Great work — closing loop after the 24h observation window. Thanks all.
